title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners — full course
creator: TechWorld with Nana
focus: Watch architecture and components first. Return for Pods, Deployments, Services, configuration and practical examples as you complete the lessons.
note: Older recording: useful foundations, but use this academy’s current four-domain syllabus and official docs for changing details.

title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners — full course
creator: TechWorld with Nana
focus: Prioritise images versus containers, image builds, registries and volumes. You do not need to master every Docker command for KCNA.
note: Optional deeper course. Docker tooling is useful context; Kubernetes does not require Docker Engine on its nodes.

title: ArgoCD Tutorial for Beginners — GitOps CD for Kubernetes
creator: TechWorld with Nana
focus: Learn Git as desired-state history, the reconciliation loop, drift and the separation between CI and application delivery.
note: Focus on concepts before the installation demo. Pair with the GitOps lesson.

title: Introduction to Argo CD & GitOps
creator: YouTube tutorial
focus: A second explanation of GitOps and Argo CD, including theory and demonstrations. Use it if you want to reinforce the delivery model.
note: Supplementary video. Apply the current official documentation when following hands-on steps.

title: Services, Ingress and Kubernetes networking
creator: Suggested YouTube search
query: Kubernetes Services Ingress networking TechWorld with Nana
focus: Look for ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, service discovery, selectors and the role of an Ingress controller.
note: This opens a curated search, not a pre-verified individual video.

title: Persistent storage: PV, PVC and StorageClass
creator: Suggested YouTube search
query: Kubernetes volumes PV PVC StorageClass TechWorld with Nana
focus: Be able to describe the path from a Pod’s PVC to a PV and the storage driver. Pay attention to ephemeral storage and reclaim policy.
note: This opens a curated search. Pair with the storage lesson and current Kubernetes documentation.

title: Prometheus, metrics and OpenTelemetry
creator: Suggested YouTube search
query: CNCF OpenTelemetry Prometheus observability introduction metrics logs traces
focus: Choose a CNCF or project-maintainer introduction. Distinguish collection, instrumentation, storage and visualization.
note: This opens a curated search. Avoid starting with an advanced installation workshop.

title: Kubernetes RBAC and ServiceAccounts
creator: Suggested YouTube search
query: Kubernetes RBAC Role ClusterRole RoleBinding ServiceAccount KodeKloud
